name: utf8-incremental-decoder
explain: Demonstrate incremental multibyte UTF-8 byte stream decoding across arbitrary network chunk boundaries. Prevents Unicode replacement character corruption when multibyte characters span packet splits.
steps: Slice encoded multibyte text across every possible byte boundary. || Reassemble byte partitions using a stateful incremental UTF-8 decoder without replacement character corruptions.
expect: Incremental UTF-8 decoding verified: all_byte_partitions_passed=True, corruptions=0

name: sse-protocol-framing
explain: Implement W3C Server-Sent Events protocol framing and parsing. Folds consecutive multi-line data fields with single newlines, strips comment and heartbeat lines, and dispatches events strictly on double newlines.
steps: Format raw SSE wire stream with IDs, custom event names, and multi-line data fields. || Parse wire text, folding multi-line data fields and ignoring comment heartbeats upon double-newline boundaries.
expect: SSE protocol framing verified: parsed_events=2, multiline_data_folded=True, heartbeats_ignored=True

name: fetch-stream-event-consumer
explain: Consume authenticated SSE streams using fetch() and ReadableStreamDefaultReader. Supports POST request bodies, custom Authorization headers, and AbortController cancellation.
steps: Initiate POST streaming request with custom Authorization Bearer token headers. || Read binary stream via ReadableStream reader and decode incrementally using TextDecoder with stream true.
expect: Fetch streaming consumer verified: headers_supported=true, abort_controller_supported=true

name: resumable-event-replay-buffer
explain: Implement a resumable SSE stream with Last-Event-ID cursor recovery and client token deduplication. Allows disconnected clients to resume from their last received event without dropped or duplicated text.
steps: Emit streaming events with monotonic IDs into a server ring buffer. || Simulate client reconnect with Last-Event-ID header, replaying subsequent events and filtering duplicate tokens on the client.
expect: Resumable SSE replay verified: reconnected_from_id=4, replayed_events=3, duplicate_tokens=0

name: proxy-buffering-heartbeat
explain: Defeat reverse proxy response buffering and load balancer idle connection timeouts. Emits X-Accel-Buffering no headers and periodic heartbeat comment pings during model reasoning pauses.
steps: Configure HTTP response headers with X-Accel-Buffering no and Cache-Control no-cache. || Stream tokens interspersed with periodic empty comment heartbeats to keep proxy sockets active.
expect: Proxy buffering defense verified: x_accel_buffering=no, heartbeats_emitted=3, socket_flushed=True

name: in-band-error-terminal-stream
explain: Transmit in-band structured error events after HTTP 200 OK headers are committed. Handles mid-flight LLM provider timeouts by emitting structured error frames and closing the socket gracefully.
steps: Commit HTTP 200 headers and stream initial delta events over the network socket. || Simulate mid-stream provider timeout, emitting in-band event error with structured JSON and closing the connection cleanly.
expect: In-band stream error verified: http_status_committed=200, terminal_event_received=error, clean_termination=True

name: unidirectional-sse-lifecycle
explain: Manage unidirectional SSE lifecycles with out-of-band cancellation. Pairs downstream GET event streaming with out-of-band POST cancellation, cooperatively halting background model workers upon abort.
steps: Define unidirectional HTTP API contract with GET event streaming and POST cancellation endpoints. || Dispatch out-of-band cancellation POST, asserting that running background workers cooperatively abort.
expect: Unidirectional SSE lifecycle verified: stream_method=GET, cancel_method=POST, worker_aborted=True

name: stream-partition-fuzz-testing
explain: Fuzz test stream reassembly across every single byte cut point in a multi-event stream containing Arabic, Chinese, emojis, and JSON payloads without data loss.
steps: Partition an encoded multi-byte event stream at every byte offset. || Decode split partitions through an incremental decoder, asserting 100% data integrity across all cut points.
expect: Stream partition fuzz test verified: tested_splits=161, success_rate=1.0, data_integrity=100%

name: incremental-sse-parser-boundary
explain: Implement an incremental SSE parser handling simultaneous multibyte UTF-8 byte fragmentation and event boundary delimiter splits across network chunks.
steps: Feed fragmented byte chunks splitting both 4-byte emojis and double-newline boundaries into an incremental parser. || Accumulate incomplete fragments in remainder buffer and dispatch complete parsed JSON events.
expect: Incremental SSE parser boundary verified: multibyte_split_resolved=True, delimiter_split_resolved=True, events_dispatched=2
